name: Windborne Flight
summary: Wisconsin flight school with two Piper Archers and a pricing list that includes fuel and sales tax.
differentiator: States its Archer rates with fuel and Wisconsin sales tax included and bases its $17,000 to $18,000 private pilot estimate on 65 hours, so the figure is closer to a final bill than many pre-tax rates.
pricing: Piper Archer at $211 or $232.10 an hour including fuel and tax, instructor $80 an hour.
